utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: Okay. Shall we start?

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: I'll take the first item.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: The bake sale is on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: Morning.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: Morning.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: First, the stall list from last week, which we agreed to shorten.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: So here it is.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: We have cakes, bread and biscuits, and the lemon tarts from the corner

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: bakery, if they can deliver before nine, which they said they probably could on the day.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: Prices stay the same: one pound a slice, two for a loaf, fifty pence a biscuit, etc.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: We need a float, a cash box, and a sign in case the card reader fails.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: Napkins are on the list again, because last time we ran out before eleven o'clock.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: The tables come from the hall, with two spare ones, maybe with cloths or covers on top.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: Someone offered a large tent, which nobody is likely to need in June.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: We said no to the tent. That's settled.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: But the one thing we still need, really, is a volunteer for the early shift at seven.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: The treasurer sent the figures from last year.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: We raised about four hundred pounds, which covered the hall and the new chairs, with some left.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: This year the target is five hundred, after costs and a small -contingency.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: We would like a raffle as well and, if possible, a

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: tombola for the children, with small prizes and a box of sweets for every ticket,

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: plus a jar to guess the number of

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: buttons in. And the hall is free to use until two, so we can stay as long as we like.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: The posters go up on Monday. Leaflets go through doors on Tuesday and Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: Bring change, bring bags, and of course bring a friend.

utterances.speaker: SPEAKER_00
utterances.text: Last item is the date for the next one, which is one one one one
